description: ACCOUNT: the calling key's balance, plan, 30-day usage by endpoint and its product-tracking allowance (snapshots a day: total, used, remaining) - the same as REST GET /v1/account. USE WHEN the user asks how many credits are left, what a job will leave, what the key has been used for, or how much tracking room there is. COST free, never billed. API key required (keyed lanes); without one, nothing to report.
name: account
